scope: Official Wan2.2 no-prompt-extension public samples; temporal_flickering scorer-level control

artifact.validation: Each selected split-ZIP member passed its declared CRC-32 check

scorer.formula: Mean over videos of (255 - mean adjacent-frame pixel MAE) / 255

interpretation: The public sample archive does not reproduce the leaderboard value under the pinned public scorer. This control does not evaluate newly generated lmms-eval videos.
